description: Anlora Agent Skills — Anthropic-format skills for AI assistants working on OnlyFans agency operations, cost modeling, and competitive landscape analysis. Stripe / Resend / Linear pattern. All skill content is sourced from publicly available material (Anlora docs + cited industry sources).

skills.name: OnlyFans Agency Operations
skills.description: Knowledge base for AI assistants advising on OnlyFans talent agency operations. Covers chatter cost economics at 5-25 creator scale, P&L structure by operating model (chatter-only, assisted-AI, autonomous AI), revenue-leakage modeling, turnover-tax accounting, and the autonomous-vs-assisted threshold. Source: meetanlora.com/docs/agency-operations.

skills.name: OnlyFans Agency Cost Benchmark
skills.description: Cost-modeling skill for OnlyFans agency total cost of ownership analysis. Includes offshore chatter wage models ($4-5/hr), management overhead ratios (1.0-2.2 seats/creator), revenue-leakage rates (5-13% scaled by agency size), and per-tool pricing data for Infloww, Supercreator, Substy AI, FlirtFlow, Creator Hero, OnlyMonster, Fans-CRM, and Anlora. Sources cited inline.

skills.name: AI Autonomous vs Assisted Threshold
skills.description: Decision-framework skill for OnlyFans agencies evaluating autonomous AI vs assisted-AI + chatter team operating models. Returns the threshold at which autonomous AI starts beating assisted-AI on TCO, parameterised by chatter wage, average revenue per creator, and revenue-leakage size. Source: meetanlora.com/docs/agency-operations#agency-operations-ai-autonomous-vs-assisted-threshold.
